prompt: A cozy university library during final exam season, where tall wooden bookshelves stretch toward the ceiling filled with countless volumes of literature, science texts, and reference materials. Students occupy every available seat at long wooden tables, their laptops glowing while surrounded by coffee cups, highlighters, and stacks of notebooks. Reading lamps cast pools of warm light across open textbooks, while a large grandfather clock in the corner marks the late evening hours. Near the circulation desk, a librarian stamps due date cards beside neat piles of returned books and a cup holder filled with pencils. However, this scholarly sanctuary maintains absolute quiet with no televisions or radios disrupting the studious atmosphere that serious academics require. You won't find any exercise equipment or weights here either, as this space dedicates itself purely to intellectual pursuits. Study carrels line the walls beneath tall windows, while comfortable armchairs cluster around low coffee tables in the reading lounge. A globe sits atop a wooden stand, and filing cabinets contain archived documents next to a photocopying machine and paper shredder.
